mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rates above 6% triggers investor concerns about labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces non-negative 5d returns when UNRATE crosses above 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in GDPC1 (total demand) and HOUST (industrial production) signal over-optimism in economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and HOUST increase by >5% from prior month
failure_condition: 60d returns not significantly negative when both proxies rise >5%.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, simultaneous high demand (GDPC1) and supply (INDPRO) signals market overvaluation, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative during periods classified as late-cycle expansion by macroeconomic indicators.

mechanism_narrative: An upward trend in INDPRO (supply index) reflects robust production capacity, reducing future price pressures and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5d returns not significantly positive when INDPRO increases by >2% month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden inflation spike (CPIAUCSL > 3.0) triggers expectations of tighter monetary policy, compressing equity valuations and leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (PAYEMS < 140,000) and low unemployment rates (UNRATE < 5.0%) create a favorable labor market environment, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60d returns not positive when both labor indicators are at favorable levels.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL during a monetary tightening cycle signal rising interest rates, compressing equity valuations and resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS increases by >1% AND CPIAUCSL increases by >0.5% over prior month
failure_condition: 20d returns not negative during periods where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise as described.
